proof_body:
by
  intro f g hf hg mf mg gf fg
  have hne : ∀ a x : ℂ, ‖a‖ < 1 → ‖x‖ < 1 → 1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x ≠ 0 := by
    intro a x ha hx h
    have h1 : (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
    have h2 : ‖a‖ * ‖x‖ = 1 := by
      have := congrArg norm h1
      simpa using this
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg a, norm_nonneg x]
  have hlt : ∀ a x : ℂ, ‖a‖ < 1 → ‖x‖ < 1 → ‖(x - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x)‖ < 1 := by
    intro a x ha hx
    have hp : 0 < ‖1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (hne a x ha hx)
    rw [norm_div, div_lt_one hp]
    have id : ‖1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x‖ ^ 2 - ‖x - a‖ ^ 2 = (1 - ‖a‖ ^ 2) * (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) := by
      simp only [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]
      simp
      ring
    have h3 : 0 < (1 - ‖a‖ ^ 2) * (1 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) := mul_pos (by nlinarith [norm_nonneg a]) (by nlinarith [norm_nonneg x])
    exact lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 2 hp.le (by linarith)
  have hinv : ∀ a x : ℂ, ‖a‖ < 1 → ‖x‖ < 1 → ((x - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x) + a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) (-a) * ((x - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x))) = x := by
    intro a x ha hx
    have h1 := hne a x ha hx
    have h3 := hne a a ha ha
    have e1 : (x - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x) + a = x * (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x) := by
      rw [div_add' _ _ _ h1]
      congr 1
      ring
    have e2 : 1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) (-a) * ((x - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x)) = (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x) := by
      rw [map_neg, neg_mul, sub_neg_eq_add, mul_div_assoc', add_div' _ _ _ h1]
      congr 1
      ring
    rw [e1, e2, div_div_div_cancel_right₀ h1, mul_div_cancel_right₀ x h3]
  have h0mem : (0 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by simp
  set a := g 0 with ha
  have han : ‖a‖ < 1 := by simpa using mg h0mem
  have hna : ‖-a‖ < 1 := by simpa using han
  set φ : ℂ → ℂ := fun x => (x - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * x) with hφ
  set ψ : ℂ → ℂ := fun x => (x - (-a)) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) (-a) * x) with hψ
  have hφm : Set.MapsTo φ (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.ball 0 1) := fun x hx =>
    mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr (hlt a x han (by simpa using hx))
  have hψm : Set.MapsTo ψ (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.ball 0 1) := fun x hx =>
    mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr (hlt (-a) x hna (by simpa using hx))
  have hφd : DifferentiableOn ℂ φ (Metric.ball 0 1) := by
    intro x hx
    apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    exact DifferentiableAt.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (hne a x han (by simpa using hx))
  have hψd : DifferentiableOn ℂ ψ (Metric.ball 0 1) := by
    intro x hx
    apply DifferentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
    exact DifferentiableAt.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (hne (-a) x hna (by simpa using hx))
  have hψφ : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, ψ (φ x) = x := fun x hx => by
    have := hinv a x han (by simpa using hx)
    simp only [hψ, hφ, sub_neg_eq_add]
    exact this
  have hφψ : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, φ (ψ x) = x := fun x hx => by
    have := hinv (-a) x hna (by simpa using hx)
    change ((x - -a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) (-a) * x) - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * ((x - -a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) (-a) * x))) = x
    simpa only [neg_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg] using this
  have hψ0 : ψ 0 = a := by simp [hψ]
  set h : ℂ → ℂ := fun x => f (ψ x) with hh
  set k : ℂ → ℂ := fun x => φ (g x) with hk
  have hhd : DifferentiableOn ℂ h (Metric.ball 0 1) := hf.comp hψd hψm
  have hkd : DifferentiableOn ℂ k (Metric.ball 0 1) := hφd.comp hg mg
  have hhm : Set.MapsTo h (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.ball 0 1) := mf.comp hψm
  have hkm : Set.MapsTo k (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.ball 0 1) := hφm.comp mg
  have kh : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, k (h z) = z := fun z hz => by
    simp only [hk, hh]
    rw [gf _ (hψm hz), hφψ z hz]
  have hk' : ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, h (k z) = z := fun z hz => by
    simp only [hk, hh]
    rw [hψφ _ (mg hz), fg z hz]
  have h00 : h 0 = 0 := by
    simp only [hh]
    rw [hψ0, ha, fg 0 h0mem]
  have hk0 : k 0 = 0 := by
    have := kh 0 h0mem
    rwa [h00] at this
  have cl : ∀ {p : ℂ → ℂ}, Set.MapsTo p (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.ball 0 1) → Set.MapsTo p (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.closedBall 0 1) := fun hm x hx => Metric.ball_subset_closedBall (hm hx)
  have hpt : (1 / 2 : ℂ) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1 := by simp; norm_num
  have hpt' : ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ < 1 := by simpa using hpt
  have hptne : (1 / 2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have h1 : ‖h (1 / 2)‖ ≤ ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ := Complex.norm_le_norm_of_mapsTo_ball hhd (cl hhm) h00 hpt'
  have h2 : ‖k (h (1 / 2))‖ ≤ ‖h (1 / 2)‖ := Complex.norm_le_norm_of_mapsTo_ball hkd (cl hkm) hk0 (by simpa using hhm hpt)
  rw [kh _ hpt] at h2
  have hn : ‖h (1 / 2)‖ = ‖(1 / 2 : ℂ)‖ := le_antisymm h1 h2
  have hm : Set.MapsTo h (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.closedBall (h 0) (1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [h00]; exact cl hhm
  have hs : ‖dslope h 0 (1 / 2)‖ = (1 : ℝ) / 1 := by
    rw [dslope_of_ne h hptne, slope_def_module, h00]
    simp only [sub_zero, norm_smul, norm_inv, hn]
    field_simp [norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hptne]
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hEq⟩ := Complex.affine_of_mapsTo_ball_of_exists_norm_dslope_eq_div' hhd hm ⟨1 / 2, hpt, hs⟩
  refine ⟨C, a, by simpa using hC, han, fun z hz => ?_⟩
  have h3 := hEq (hφm hz)
  have h5 : h (φ z) = f z := by
    simp only [hh]
    rw [hψφ z hz]
  change f z = C * φ z
  simpa [h00, h5, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using h3
target_source: ∀ (f g : ℂ → ℂ), DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball 0 1) → DifferentiableOn ℂ g (Metric.ball 0 1) → Set.MapsTo f (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.ball 0 1) → Set.MapsTo g (Metric.ball 0 1) (Metric.ball 0 1) → (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, g (f z) = z) → (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, f (g z) = z) → ∃ u a : ℂ, ‖u‖ = 1 ∧ ‖a‖ < 1 ∧ ∀ z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) 1, f z = u * ((z - a) / (1 - (starRingEnd ℂ) a * z))
